name: Dropbox
whatYouLose: Reliable cross-device sync and conflict resolution
Global storage durability, recovery and bandwidth infrastructure
Native desktop and mobile clients with offline support
prompt: Build a small-team file portal, not a Dropbox clone. Users can upload files to object storage, organize folders, create share links, set expiry dates, preview common formats, restore recent versions, search metadata and audit downloads. Use Astro SSR, vanilla JavaScript and SQLite for metadata. Use direct multipart uploads and signed URLs. Explicitly exclude desktop folder synchronization and offline clients.
notes: A file portal is easy. Invisible, trustworthy synchronization across devices is the product—and it is brutally difficult.
